From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Satellite Demo Days — partner program coordination

Hi Leah,

Great to meet you at the summit last month — thanks again for the quick chat about doing a regional "Satellite Demo Days" series together. We talked about a 3-city run (SF, Austin, Boston) that mixes a short Redwood-led product demo with an OrbitWorks customer showcase.

We'd love to move from concept to a concrete mutual action plan. High-level asks from our side:
- MDF framework (ballpark per-city budget)
- Headcount estimate for booth/support per city
- Preferred weekend vs. weekday windows for each city

I'll loop Marissa and Grace on logistics and field ops. Readouts: we can provide a joint landing page, promo email copy, and demo engineers.

If you can share a simple MDF/terms draft and ideal dates for June–Sept, I can align internal budget and calendar.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
(Attachment: none in this message)

From: Leah Park <leah@orbitworks.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@orbitworks.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Satellite Demo Days — partner program coordination

Thanks Karthik — excited to get this scoped. Quick answers:
- MDF: we typically budget $8k–12k per city for joint booth + local ads; want Redwood to nominate preferred level and use-case priorities.
- Headcount: 3 OrbitWorks staff + 1 local AE per city; plan for 1 Redwood engineer + 1 ops contact.
- Dates: June weekend dates are tight for us (product launch), but late July and mid-September look good.

I'll attach a short partner brief from our side (see partners@orbitworks.com thread). Also, we'd prefer a 50/50 co-branded registration page and combined promo cadence.

Leah Park
Head of Partnerships, OrbitWorks
leah@orbitworks.com
(Attachments: orbit-partner-brief.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Park <leah@orbitworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Satellite Demo Days — partner program coordination

Hi Leah — thanks for the quick reply and the brief. Attached is a draft MDF term sheet and a preliminary booth layout for a 10x10 co-branded space. Quick highlights from our side:
- Suggested MDF: $10k per city with a 60/40 split (OrbitWorks/Redwood) on ad spend to reflect lead ownership and phone follow-up.
- Promotional cadence: shared landing page + two co-email blasts (2 weeks and 5 days out). Redwood will provide demo copy + assets.
- Logistics ask: OrbitWorks to cover local catering and event permits; Redwood will cover demo hardware and on-site AV.

Action items:
1) Leah: confirm MDF level and whether OrbitWorks can commit to PO or purchase order by May 25.
2) Marissa: can you confirm Redwood on-site travel budget and estimated headcount by EOD Friday?
3) Grace: can you review the booth layout and let us know if we should reserve a 10x20 instead?

Attaching: RDW_MDF_term_sheet_v1.pdf; satellite-demo-booth-layout.png; mutual-action-plan.xlsx

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
(Attachments: RDW_MDF_term_sheet_v1.pdf, satellite-demo-booth-layout.png, mutual-action-plan.xlsx)

Thanks Karthik / Leah — quick ops check from Redwood field marketing:
- Travel & headcount: we can confirm 1 engineer + 1 field marketer per city; if OrbitWorks needs a second Redwood engineer for deep-dive sessions we can escalate.
- Booth size: recommend 10x20 for SF (higher foot traffic), 10x10 for Austin/Boston. Grace, please greenlight if this matches inventory.
- PO / billing: Leah — we typically need a signed DocuSign and a HubSpot deal record before finance issues MDF credits. Sharing links in thread for convenience: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7654321 and DocuSign placeholder (see below).

If OrbitWorks can confirm PO number and sign the term sheet by May 25 we can reserve the SF 10x20 footprint and lock promo dates.
